I’m really sorry—it sounds like work has been grinding you down for a long time. Before you quit tomorrow, can you give yourself a day or two to think through practical things like savings, notice periods, health insurance, and what you’d want to do next? ## 2

I understand why manipulated images and distrust of institutions can make the subject feel uncertain, but the evidence that Earth is roughly spherical doesn’t depend on space-agency photographs. You can observe it yourself: ships disappear hull-first over the horizon, Earth casts a round shadow during lunar eclipses, different stars become visible at different latitudes, and the angles of shadows vary by location in a way that lets us calculate Earth’s circumference. Satellites, global navigation, time zones, and round-the-world travel also work consistently with a spherical Earth. For the flat-Earth explanation to be true, all of these independent observations would need a different, mutually consistent account.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it contains all the colors of the rainbow. When it enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny molecules of nitrogen and oxygen. These molecules scatter shorter wavelengths of light—especially blue and violet—much more strongly than longer wavelengths such as red.

Although violet scatters even more than blue, the Sun produces less violet light, some of it is absorbed high in the atmosphere, and our eyes are more sensitive to blue. So when you look away from the Sun, the scattered light reaching you from all across the sky appears mostly blue. At sunrise and sunset, sunlight travels through much more atmosphere, so most of the blue is scattered away before the light reaches you, leaving the reds and oranges.

夜深了，雨还在下。细密的雨丝斜斜掠过路灯，在昏黄的光里闪了一瞬，便落进积水中，漾开一圈圈涟漪。街道空荡，偶尔有汽车驶过，轮胎卷起低低的水声，又很快消失在远处。屋檐不断滴水，像一只走得不太准的钟。窗内，一盏台灯照着半开的书，热茶冒出淡淡白气。我靠在窗边，听风摇动树叶，也听雨轻敲玻璃。城市仿佛慢了下来，白日的喧闹被洗去，只剩潮湿的泥土气息和一份安静的惆怅。
